description: Render coordinated charts and KPIs from shared datasets and panel definitions. Use it when composing a dashboard; use viz_render instead for one chart or artifact_certify to grade each returned normalized chart. Returns layout, per-panel specs/hashes, computed KPI values, accessibility data and a reusable specRef. output.includeNormalizedSpec includes panel IR; output.html adds rendered HTML. brand/theme controls emitted pixels; selection and crossFilter apply caller-supplied filtering. resolveMeasures defaults true for governed measure references. output.contrastScan is a four-pair token preflight, not whole-document certification. Chord and flow_map are excluded from dashboards. Reference: TOOL-REFERENCE.md#dashboard_render; full schema: oods://schemas/dashboard_render.input.json.

a11y.description: SEAM (d) dashboard-level accessibility: a cross-panel summary + reading/focus order. The per-chart AccessibilitySpec stays per-panel; this is the dashboard envelope.

a11yEquivalence.description: A11y equivalence CERTIFY-AT-EMISSION switch. See full schema for details.

brand.description: CSS token brand for the dashboard document and chart pixels; defaults to A. The contrast scan grades the same scoped document tokens.

crossFilter.description: Active selection combination. Each active source contributes a predicate; ignoreSelfSource controls whether its own panel is filtered. Declared links do not change this behavior.

datasets.description: SEAM (a) cross-panel DATA-SHARING. Shared, named tabular datasets. Tabular chart panels and KPI panels reference one by `datasetId`; sharing a dataset is what makes cross-filter possible (panels filter the same dimensional space).

items.description: A named shared dataset. Panels reference it by id; cross-filter operates over its shared dimensional space.

id.description: Stable identifier for the dashboard instance.

layout.description: Optional layout hints consumed by the deterministic auto-layout resolver. Absent hints -> declared panel order + KPI-row-first defaults; the resolver emits abstract {x,y,w,h} (renderer-agnostic, the client sizes the canvas).

links.description: Declared panel relationships, returned in the result and rendered as a labelled reference list in HTML. They do not apply filters. Active cross-filtering uses selection and crossFilter.

items.description: A declared source-to-target relationship displayed in the HTML reference list. See full schema for details.

onPanelError.description: SEAM (b) partial-panel ERROR policy. 'placeholder' = render an a11y-described error panel in-place (default — don't void the dashboard); 'omit' = drop the failed panel from the layout.

compact.description: When true, omit full token CSS and return a tokenCssRef instead.

contrastScan.description: A11y completeness. See full schema for details.

dataQualityField.description: A11y completeness. See full schema for details.

dataTable.description: A11y completeness. See full schema for details.

echarts.description: When true, also include the ECharts option for tabular panels (ECharts-primary panels always include it).

html.description: Opt-in render-to-SVG export. See full schema for details.

includeA11y.description: When true, attach a STRUCTURED two-part text alternative (accessible data table +… See full schema for details.

includeNormalizedSpec.description: When true, also return each successfully rendered chart panel's intermediate… See full schema for details.

panels.description: Heterogeneous panels: chart (11 of the 13 viz.render chartTypes; chord and flow_map are viz.render-only — plus its data branch) or kpi tiles.

items.description: A dashboard panel: a chart panel (11 of the 13 viz.render chartTypes; chord and flow_map… See full schema for details.

resolveMeasures.description: Phase-3 governed-measure RESOLUTION switch. See full schema for details.

schemaVersion.description: IR version discriminant (V01 convention). A future template/shape change bumps to v0.2.

additionalProperties.description: One panel's active cross-filter selection (point/categorical only in v1).

selection.description: Optional accumulated cross-filter SelectionState, keyed by sourceWidgetId (one active selection per source). See full schema for details.

strictDatasets.description: Unknown-datasetId STRICT switch. See full schema for details.

strictFields.description: Field-presence STRICT switch. See full schema for details.

theme.description: CSS token theme for chart pixels, default light. See full schema for details.

title.description: Human-friendly dashboard title surfaced in UI + narration.

tokenCssRef.description: SEAM (e) TOKEN strategy. See full schema for details.
